I'm Hazwan, a product designer and creative developer who likes finding the clear line through complicated things.

That might mean turning scattered research into a useful product system, giving a thoughtful studio an identity, or building a workspace that helps a team ask better questions.

I work where structure meets expression. The goal is always the same: make something useful feel natural to use.

Selected work / Product system study

Northstar

From scattered signals
to shared direction.

Research loses its value when useful insights stay buried in folders. Northstar explores a calmer way to find, frame and share the customer signals that matter.

The design decision

Keep evidence connected to every insight. A shared vocabulary makes information easier to retrieve; a focused reading view gives each finding room to be understood.

Selected work / Visual identity study

Lumen

A small identity.
A wide world.

A portable identity for a studio making thoughtful tools for teams. The challenge: express a clear point of view without tying the studio to a single kind of product.

The design decision

A simple aperture becomes the centre of a flexible visual language. Quiet typography and deliberate space let the work speak; the symbol brings a recognisable rhythm across screen and print.

Brand strategyVisual identityDigital direction

Selected work / Workspace study

Field Notes

Keep the question
open a little longer.

Not every good idea starts with an answer. Field Notes is a flexible workspace for the questions, observations and unfinished thoughts that keep teams curious.

The design decision

Start with a thought, then give it structure when it's ready. Notes can grow from loose observations into connected themes, keeping the original context close as the team's understanding develops.
